meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十条原则逐条给设计打分（0–3 分，每条附证据），判定 NEW、REFINE 或 REDESIGN，并生成一份可直接粘贴的 /make-plan 提示词，结果写入 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 目录。
howto.when: 当你说「audit this design」「design review」「critique this design」等关键词，或需要一次能引出计划的设计评审时触发。常规 UI 代码审查、纯文案修改不适用。

say.text: 按 Rams 十条原则审一下这个设计
say.note: 先锁定审计范围，再收集证据并逐条打分

say.text: 给这个界面做一次 design review，给出结论
审完之后给我一份可粘贴的 /make-plan 提示词

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scoring each 0–3 with cited evidence, picks a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict, and writes a copy-pasteable /make-plan prompt into a DESIGN-IS-<date>/ folder. It writes no implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design", "design review", "critique this design" and similar, or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan. Not for routine UI code reviews or pure copy edits.

say_en.text: Audit this design against the ten Rams principles
say_en.note: Locks scope first, then gathers evidence and scores each principle

say_en.text: Do a design review of this UI and give me a verdict
say_en.note: Produces a scorecard plus a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict

say_en.text: After the audit, give me the /make-plan handoff prompt
say_en.note: Written to 04-handoff-prompt.md, readable with no extra lookups
